preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
All characters in the string s must be lowercase letters.
The integer k must be greater than zero.

postconditions.description: The function returns a non-negative integer representing the length of the longest valid substring.
The length of the longest valid substring cannot exceed the length of the input string s.

postconditions.expression: any(all(s.count(c) >= k for c in set(sub)) for sub in [s[i:j] for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i+1, len(s)+1)])
postconditions.description: There exists at least one substring of s where every character appears at least k times.
